units.source_text: 青莲院和尚拎着提灯相迎和看岛原角屋的高级艺伎这两个节目倒是蛮好的。”

en.t: The two activities, being welcomed by the monk of Shoren-in carrying a lantern and seeing the high-class geisha at Sumiya in Shimabara, were quite nice.

units.source_text: 千重子答道，“我记得这些事，好像从前曾说过……”

en.t: Chieko answered, "I remember those things. It seems as if I mentioned them before..."
